# The handle made for Mum

The larger loop lets Mum lift the mug without pinching her fingers. She prefers the weight of the old chipped one anyway. Keep both. [[Pottery]]: a successful adaptation need not replace a familiar object. Ask which cup she reaches for over several weeks, rather than turning the first appreciative comment into a product review.
